history.content: Design a single-floor home, plot 50 feet wide and 50 feet long, south-facing entrance. Exactly 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms total. Attach one bathroom each to bedrooms [1, 2]; all remaining bathrooms are common. Include living room, separate dining room, kitchen, pooja room. No parking. Keep hallway space compact, bedrooms balanced, and kitchen next to dining. Record these requirements and prepare to generate.

Your plot is 50 ft × 50 ft with a south‑facing entrance, and you’ve specified 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms. Bedrooms 1 and 2 each have an attached bathroom, while the third bathroom is shared. You also want a living room, a separate dining room, a kitchen, and a pooja room, with a compact hallway, balanced bedroom placement, and the kitchen next to the dining area.

When you’re ready, click **“Generate 3D home”**. Let me know if you’d like any final tweaks before we proceed!
Your changes have been applied to the floor plan and 3D model.
